title: WhatsApp
intro: The WhatsApp numbers agencies use through MSG91, and the webhook MSG91 calls.
notConfigured: WhatsApp is not set up on this server. Set the three MSG91 settings and restart.
empty: No agency has a WhatsApp number yet. Record one on the agency's page.
cancelled: Subscription cancelled, number still connected: remove it in MSG91's panel and disconnect it here.
problemBanner: No delivery reports from MSG91 for a connected number after sending. Check the webhook in MSG91's panel.

unrouted.title: Numbers nobody recorded
unrouted.intro: MSG91 sent events for these numbers, but no agency has recorded them.

webhook.title: Webhook for MSG91's panel
webhook.intro: Paste the address and the header once in MSG91's WhatsApp panel under Webhook (New). Turn on inbound messages and delivery reports.

group.title: WhatsApp
group.none: No WhatsApp number is recorded for this agency.
group.waiting: Waiting for the first message: send a WhatsApp to {number} from any phone.

cannot.NO_INBOX_MODULE: The plan does not include the inbox.
cannot.NO_NUMBER_LIMIT: The plan has no WhatsApp number.
cannot.NOT_SEEN: No message from MSG91 has arrived for this number yet.

group.loadFailed: This agency's WhatsApp details didn't load.
group.notConfigured: WhatsApp is not set up on this server.

connect.title: Connect a WhatsApp number
connect.description: Record the number the agency's customers message, as MSG91 has it. It starts as Setting up and is marked connected after MSG91's first message arrives.
connect.integratedNumber: The number as MSG91 writes it
connect.integratedHint: Digits with the country code, for example 919876543210
connect.mode: How it is added in MSG91
connect.modeCoexistence: With the WhatsApp Business app on the phone
connect.done: The number is recorded. Send a WhatsApp to it to see the webhook arrive.

disconnectConfirm.title: Stop WhatsApp for {agency}?
disconnectConfirm.description: Chats stay. Remove the number in MSG91's panel too.
